ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water is useful (good for you).
   B. In my house there is a kitchen.
   C. I am in Grade 4.
   D. Thank you for listening.

2. Which Arabic sentence means "The table is small." (1 mark)
   A. النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ
   B. الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ
   C. الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ
   D. الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ

3. How do you read the syllable سَ? (1 mark)
   A. li
   B. na
   C. mi
   D. sa

4. How do you read the syllable لُ? (1 mark)
   A. ti
   B. lu
   C. la
   D. su

5. How is the Arabic word رِجْلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sinn
   B. rijl
   C. dhahr
   D. raqaba

6. What does the Arabic sentence السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fish is delicious.
   B. I like food.
   C. Water is useful (good for you).
   D. The juice is cold.

7. Which letter begins the word taawila? (1 mark)
   A. daal, د
   B. Taa, the heavy ط
   C. taa, the light ت
   D. thaa, ث

8. How is the Arabic word اسْمِي read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. anaa bi-khayr
   B. wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam
   C. ismii
   D. sabaahu n-nuur

9. Which Arabic word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. أَبٌ
   B. جَدٌّ
   C. أُمٌّ
   D. بِنْتٌ

10. What should you check on a food chart before posting it? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. The spelling, dots and marks
   C. Only the date
   D. Only the colour

11. Which sound does the Arabic letter د make? (1 mark)
   A. s as in sun
   B. f as in fan
   C. d as in dog
   D. m as in mat

12. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. In the room there is a bed.
   C. This is my room.
   D. I like my house.

13. How do you read the syllable مُ? (1 mark)
   A. na
   B. tu
   C. nu
   D. mu

14. Which Arabic word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. شَمْسٌ
   B. مُشْمِسٌ
   C. مُمْطِرٌ
   D. غَائِمٌ

15. What does the Arabic word بَطْنٌ (batn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. finger
   C. stomach
   D. mouth

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: fii l-ghurfati sariir (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii and atakallamu bi-famii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? (2 marks)

19. Explain why we should show respect when we greet people of a different gender or culture. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Describe three ways to work out the meaning of an unfamiliar word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Give three things you can do to listen attentively. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Thank you for listening.
   شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

2. D — الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ
   الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

3. D — sa
   سَ is read sa.

4. B — lu
   لُ is read lu.

5. B — rijl
   رِجْلٌ is read rijl and means leg.

6. A — The fish is delicious.
   السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ (as-samaku ladhiidh) means: The fish is delicious.

7. B — Taa, the heavy ط
   طَاوِلَةٌ begins with the heavy letter Taa.

8. C — ismii
   اسْمِي is read ismii and means my name is.

9. C — أُمٌّ
   أُمٌّ (umm) means mother.

10. B — The spelling, dots and marks
   Checking the words helps to avoid mistakes.

11. C — d as in dog
   The letter د makes the sound d as in dog.

12. C — This is my room.
   هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي (haadhihi ghurfatii) means: This is my room.

13. D — mu
   مُ is read mu.

14. A — شَمْسٌ
   شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

15. C — stomach
   بَطْنٌ (batn) means stomach.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the room there is a bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: I see with my eye. I speak with my mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each translation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do you like bananas?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greeting customs can differ. Using polite words and a smile shows respect. Respect helps boys and girls, men and women to be treated equally and to live peacefully.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for customs differ, 1 mark for polite words, 1 mark for equality or peace.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use the sentence around the word; use a picture or a word you know; look it up in a dictionary or ask.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the speaker; do not talk while someone is speaking; think about the topic; listen for words you know; ask a question at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid behaviour, up to 3.
